title: Figures 14-15: Closed Brayton cycle and 110-watt positron Stirling generator schematics
description: Figure 14 is a numbered flow schematic (points 1-6) linking an e+ "Heater-Attenuator," "Regenerator," "Turbine," "Compressor," "Radiator" and "Work (Alternator)"; caption: "Figure 14. Closed Brayton Cycle Using Positron Annihilation (courtesy Positronics Research LLC)." Figure 15 shows a cutaway of twin Stirling convertors (55 We each) flanking "Ps Storage" with cryocooler units and an electric power outlet, plus an end view with tungsten converter, magnetic sleeve and gamma rays. Caption: "Figure 15. Conceptual 110-Watt Positron Closed-Cycle Generator Based on the NASA Glenn Research Center Stirling Radioisotope Generator."
